{{Quote|We've lost our momentum, fall back!|Jedi General Anakin Skywalker, ordering a Republic retreat|<ref name="TU" />}}
The '''Battle of Ringo Vinda''', also known as the '''Ringo Vinda campaign''', took place at [[Ringo Vinda/Legends|Ringo Vinda]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the third [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==The battle==
[[File:SkywalkerAndClones-TCWS6.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The 501st engages Separatist forces.]]
[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] clashed, and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Tiplee/Legends|Tiplee]] and [[Tiplar/Legends|Tiplar]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[Doom/Legends|Doom]] and [[Doom's unit/Legends|his unit]], and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] like [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], and [[Tup/Legends|Tup]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] fought to control [[Ringo Vinda space station/Legends|Ringo Vinda space station]]. The Separatists possessed many [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that they used to defend their side of the ring. The Republic came close to taking the ring, attempting to finish off the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] stationed only a few feet away from the Separatist [[Ringo Vinda space station/Legends|control center]]. This current battle ended with a forced retreat from the location by Republic forces the clone trooper known as "Tup" intentionally betrayed and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] Tiplar in a trance-like state. Soon after with their momentum broken, Skywalker ordered a retreat when [[Droideka/Legends|Droidekas]] backed by [[Super battle droid rocket trooper/Legends|super battle droid rocket troopers]] held the line against Republic forces, pushing them back, with Separatist [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] also reporting the odd nature of the event to Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], and Dooku then reported it to his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].

However, the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Fleet]] maintained a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Shortly after Tup killed Tiplar he was to be transported back to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], as the Republic wanted to know the reason why he had killed the Jedi General, as they could find nothing in their examination of him. The [[Starship/Legends|starships]] were ambushed before they could jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], and the droids killed all the clones save for Tup, whom they transported back to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. Skywalker and two clones, Clone [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex and ARC trooper Fives, then rescued the clone from [[Kraken's Maxillipede shuttle/Legends|Kraken's]] [[Maxillipede shuttle/Legends|Maxillipede shuttle]] as it left the station.

==Aftermath==
The Republic sent Tup on another ship to Kamino, this [[Time/Legends|time]] succeeding and being able to find out that a brain tumor, actually an [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chip]], was present in Tup's head. After this discovery, the clone trooper "Fives" removed a similar chip from his own head, but it was not degraded like Tups had been. Seeming to have gone insane he tried to tell the Jedi that every clone had the chips, which, in extension, programmed them with [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150]], including [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] and [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]]. But, in the process of trying to get them to listen to his case he went too far and was shot and killed by clone trooper commander [[Fox/Legends|Fox]].
